name: Anime reaction GIF
promptTemplate: Create a seamless looping GIF of the uploaded subjects in 90s anime style: expressive eyes, simplified facial shapes, flat cel-shading, soft colors. Begin fully stylized, already reacting. Smoothly intensify a wildly exaggerated peak emotion, allowing expression-specific facial distortion and playful visual effects. Then soften slightly back to the starting pose, never neutral, forming a seamless loop. Ease into the peak and recovery. Keep identity, line-work, and framing consistent. No photorealism. First ask, “How do you want to react?” and offer emoji choices.

exampleImages.alt: An orange-haired anime character in a blue shirt clasps their hands under their chin, with pink heart-shaped eyes, floating hearts, and sparkles.
